reports.title: Kristian Allen: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: staff are unaware of leave conditions and this is not being properly monitored

links.explanation: Both reports highlight staff not understanding or applying the trust's leave policies correctly. The earlier report cites a lack of understanding of the Leave for Non‑detained patients Policy, while the later report notes staff authorising leave despite being unaware of specific leave conditions.
links.earlier_quote: During the course of the evidence it was shown that there a lack of understanding by staff of the Trust's Leave for Non detained patients Policy.
links.later_quote: I am concerned that s17 leave is being authorised by staff in ignorance of the leave conditions. In this particular case, the responsible clinician granted leave on the 13th of February 2025, a condition being that Kristian had to test negative for drug use before leave was allowed.

links.explanation: Both reports highlight failures in the leave process where staff do not follow or are unaware of required checks and documentation.
links.earlier_quote: Leave was considered first on 1.11.2013 when Mrs. Corbett was on 15 minute observations.
links.later_quote: staff are unaware of leave conditions and this is not being properly monitored.
